description: A frozen-policy short-horizon search on four Training-only seeds found no safe improvement for the 60 N positive-y impact, but found one negative-y intervention that improved terminal recovery-target progress on both independent 49 N cases while reducing disallowed self-contact steps from two to zero. The first always-on 24-frame distillation overfit this local basin and failed the continuous Judge. Use 24 counterfactual teacher frames plus 38 frozen-policy anchors from the no-improvement side, lower the coefficient to 0.01, and linearly retire supervision by step 8192 while preserving the complete no-reset Mission progression, Program prior, lateral-only authority, bilateral consistency regularizer, seed, budget, and locked Judge.
